caption: The drawing is composed of multiple outlined template shapes, organized within a rectangular frame on a beige background. The outlines are rendered in thin, gray lines. Text labels and numbers accompany each shape, indicating specific parts or instructions, such as "CENTER FRONT," "CENTER BACK," "CUT ON FOLD," and numbered sections (e.g., A1, A2, B2, C1, C2, etc.). The largest shapes are rectangular and oriented horizontally in the bottom half of the frame, each labeled for placement, such as "CENTER BACK CUT ON FOLD" and "CENTER FRONT CUT ON FOLD." Smaller, irregularly shaped pieces, such as curved and angular segments, are positioned in the upper half of the frame, including pieces labeled "CENTER FRONT," "CENTER BACK," and other corresponding notations. Narrow rectangular strips are arranged vertically along the right side, each marked with additional text and numbers, such as "DS," "D6," and "D7." Several sections contain evenly spaced vertical lines or dots, possibly to indicate pleats, darts, or fold lines. The paper is light brown with some subtle signs of aging around the edges, and no other colors or decorative elements are present.
